messages:
Noah (Design): Heads up 1: on narrow phones the persistent bottom action footer overlaps the table pagination when the on-screen keyboard opens (search input focused). Repro on iPhone SE + Android small.
Liz (Product): Oof. Does it block taps or just visually overlap?
Noah (Design): Both. The footer stays fixed and the keyboard pushes the table up; pagination controls end up under the footer and are untappable. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/footer-overlap.png
Owen (Frontend): Sounds like fixed positioning + viewport resize issue. On mobile 100vh changes when keyboard opens. We used `height: 100vh` for the content container which is the culprit.
Rina (Mobile): In WebView the keyboard resize behavior varies by platform. iOS doesn't resize viewport; Android often does. We need a robust approach that handles both.
Liz (Product): UX ask: keep footer accessible, avoid hiding pagination. Proposal: move pagination into a compact inline control above the table when viewport height < 500px, and keep footer as action-only (no pagination).
Noah (Design): Agree. Also suggest making the footer taller on touch devices and convert text labels to icons when vertical space is constrained. Keep primary CTA full-width to avoid accidental taps.
Owen (Frontend): Technical plan: 1) stop using 100vh for layout; use `height: calc(var(--vh, 1vh) * 100)` with JS to set --vh on resize. 2) detect keyboard by checking window.innerHeight delta and toggle `compact-pagination` class when height < 500px. 3) ensure pagination controls are moved into DOM above footer for keyboard mode.
Rina (Mobile): Note: measuring viewport changes needs debounce (100ms) to avoid thrash when keyboard animates. Also on iOS we may need to use focus/blur heuristics since innerHeight doesn't change.
Owen (Frontend): Accessibility: when moving pagination into the inline area ensure focus order is preserved and announce with `aria-live` region: "Pagination moved above actions due to reduced screen height".
Noah (Design): Copy tweak: keep the button label for the condensed footer as "Run" for primary and use a tooltip for other icons: long-press shows label. Also ensure 44px hit target.
Liz (Product): Next steps: Owen to prototype `--vh` approach + keyboard height detection; Rina to test on real devices; Noah to mock compact pagination; I'll log for sprint planning.
Infra-Bot: Ticket created RDC-1422: "Mobile keyboard - footer overlaps pagination (compact pagination fallback)" and linked this thread.
Owen (Frontend): I'll push a short PR with the `--vh` polyfill and a small JS listener. Will add notes about debounce and feature flag. :rocket:
